tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description: $0.00 free search of bounded public StackBench benchmark and failure evidence; use this for evidence-only requests.

tools.name: check_deployment_fit
tools.description: $0.01 USDC on Base mainnet: check model/configuration fit against bounded StackBench capacity evidence.

tools.name: predict_performance
tools.description: $0.05 USDC: predict configuration throughput, memory, and power from bounded StackBench evidence with confidence, missing metrics, and caveats.
